description_en: Queries the vCPU and memory usage of an instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeInstanceMonitorData查询实例CPU和内存的使用情况
name: DescribeInstanceMonitorData

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. You can specify only one instance ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. If the value of the seconds place is not 00, the start time is automatically set to the next minute
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的起始时间点。

按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。如果秒不是00，则自动取为下一分钟开始时
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. If the value of the seconds place is not 00, the start time is automatically set to the next minute
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的结束时间点。

按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。如果秒不是00，则自动取为下一分钟开始时
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The precision of the monitoring data that you want to obtain. Valid values: 60, 300, 1200, 3600, and 14400. Default value: 60. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 获取监控数据的精度，取值：60（默认值）、300、1200、3600及14400，单位：秒
parameters.name: period

Code.description_en: The returned service code. A value of 0 indicates that the operation was successful
